visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a tight white turtleneck sweater and a black pleated mini-skirt with black stockings, sits cross-legged on a bright green artificial turf. She waves her right hand at the camera with a bright smile. On the turf in front of her are several white golf balls and two empty clear cups. The background is a dark outdoor golf driving range at night, with tall metal net structures and bright floodlights visible. (2) The woman leans forward and places both hands on the two cups. She begins a rapid, rhythmic shuffling motion, sliding the cups over the golf balls on the green turf. Her movements are fast and energetic. Her facial expression remains focused yet cheerful throughout the task. (3) She stops the shuffling motion and brings the two cups together in the center. Both cups are now stacked with golf balls. She sits back upright, points at the cups with both hands, and gives a proud, playful look to the camera. (4) She picks up the cups and offers them toward the camera lens. A hand enters from the right side of the frame to take one of the cups. The woman smiles broadly, laughs, and briefly covers her mouth with her right hand. The background remains the lit-up driving range.
